g.text: CPU depth batch validation: timing and temporary allocation
Contiguous float32 depth + bool validity; complete SensorPipeline._validate, including capture stamps and layouts.
One warmup + nine alternating measured pairs; bars show medians, timing whiskers show IQR. Shared unpinned CPU, one BLAS/OMP thread.
Timing excludes tracing and hashing. Allocation excludes inputs and is not RSS. Rendering, cache copies, recording and training are outside this figure.
